documents_why: [R-CAL-02] / [R-CAL-03], added 03-Sep-2026 when this gate was extended to the DELIVERED STUDY DOCUMENTS. It had always read the SITE — html and js — and a delivered study is as public a surface as a web page. ARCC's shipped study published the retired skill verdict twice and a band flag its own record does not earn, and nothing could see either: each study's own scrub checks INTERNAL-PROCEDURE vocabulary and knows nothing about verdicts, this gate knows about verdicts and never looked at the study, and between them the surface was uncovered. The scan is scoped to the DELIVERED edition per L-067, so a superseded file nobody receives cannot make this permanently red. Three current editions predate the extension and are listed; each is cleared at that study's next re-issue and the list may only ever SHORTEN. [05-Sep-2026] THREE MORE, AND THE PATTERN THAT MISSED THEM WAS DEFEATED BY A HYPHEN. The 03-Sep widening added "skill against a simple random walk" after ARCC shipped it, with a comment saying a rule of this kind "is not enforced by banning the word people happened to use for it last time" — and the next three documents wrote "random-WALK BENCHMARK" and "no-information benchmark", which none of those patterns match. The patterns now match the SHAPE of the claim: a comparison of this house's cone against a benchmark stated as a number, and the name of the scoring rule that produced it. One of the three is the EXEMPLAR.
